author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Manic Android malware combines banking fraud and spyware, using a Bluetooth relay to steal data even when devices are offline. title: Manic: The Android Malware That Exfiltrates Data Even When the Phone Is Offline

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: NSA, CISA, FBI, DOE, and EPA warn of active AI-assisted attacks against Siemens S7 PLCs across US critical infrastructure sectors. The advisory, CISA AA26-231A, is co-signed by NSA, FBI, DOE, and EPA […]
title: NSA, CISA, FBI, DOE, and EPA Warn of Active AI-Assisted Attacks on Siemens S7 PLCs

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) adds an MLflow vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. CVE-2026-64849 is a critical server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in MLflow, a […]
title: U.S. CISA adds an MLflow flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
